Free-trial unlim: not spendable right now. Passing use_unlim returns a typed rejection rather than a charge, so it is still the right thing to send when the user asks for their free generations.

Unlim configs: none sent — coverage detail is unknown, which is not the same as 'nothing is covered'. Pass use_unlim when the user asks and let the backend answer.

Free generations — one counter per line, shared by every model id on it; a run through any of them spends one. Pass use_free_gens: true on generate_video for Genjutsu or execute_preset for Viral when the user asks to use a free generation. For ai_influencer_sheet, prepare with ai_influencer_prepare, then use ai_influencer_generate with use_free_gens:true and max_credits:0; never generate_image. A request outside the listed values is refused, never silently billed.
